::api-operation{method="DELETE" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/items/{item}"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |
| `item` | `string` | **yes** | The subscription item's id (si_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `subscription_item`. One of `subscription_item`. |
| `id` | `string` | The subscription item id. |
| `removed` | `boolean` | Always true. |
| `credit_note` | `object` | The largest credit note, or null if none was raised. |
| `credit_notes` | `array of object` | Every credit note that the removal raised. One item billed on several invoices gets one note for each. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Removed |
| `400` | This item cannot be removed: the prorated credit it owes could not be issued — or no such item |
| `404` | No such subscription or business |
| `409` | A concurrent write invalidated the credit this removal priced — retry; or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X DELETE "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/items/si_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
